title: LeanPolish: Verified Supervision for Lean Proof Compression
abstract: arXiv:2609.38384v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Verified proof edits offer a natural source of supervision for improving language-model-generated Lean proofs. Yet verification establishes that an edit is correct, not that its training signal is free of search artifacts. We introduce LeanPolish, a symbolic Lean 4 pipeline that releases 33,402 accepted local edits and 65,596 same-state failed attempts, and use it to study what models learn from this supervision. First-success search admits a goal-independent rule with perfect ranking accuracy; teacher-selected evaluation sites also reward trivial deletions. Continuing menu evaluation beyond the first success removes the ordering shortcut: a trained ranker selects the best candidate on 70.1% of evaluated held-out states, versus 36.9% for the strongest frozen baseline. For compression, iterating the symbolic pass raises miniF2F savings from 19.7% to 27.5%, exceeding the neural hybrids we test there. Verified neural editing helps on other

translated_title: LeanPolish：用于Lean证明压缩的经过验证的监督
translated_abstract: 经过验证的证明编辑为改进语言模型生成的Lean证明提供了一种天然的监督来源。然而，验证只能确认某个编辑是正确的，并不能保证其训练信号中没有搜索过程带来的伪影。我们提出了LeanPolish，一个符号化的Lean 4流水线，它发布了33,402个被接受的局部编辑和65,596个处于相同状态的失败尝试，并利用它来研究模型从这种监督中究竟学到了什么。首次成功式搜索允许一个与目标无关的规则达到完美的排序准确率；教师选择的评估位置也会奖励无关紧要的删除。将菜单评估延续到首次成功之后可以消除这种顺序捷径：训练出的排序器在70.1%的被评估保留状态上选出最佳候选，而最强的冻结基线仅为36.9%。在压缩方面，对符号处理过程的迭代使miniF2F上的节省比例从19.7%提升到27.5%，超过了我们在该场景下测试的神经混合方法。经过验证的神经编辑在其他……
tldr: LeanPolish是一个符号化Lean 4流水线，通过发布大规模经过验证的局部编辑数据并揭示并消除搜索顺序捷径等监督伪影，使训练出的排序器远超基线，并将miniF2F证明压缩的节省率从19.7%提升至27.5%。
en_tdlr: LeanPolish is a symbolic Lean 4 pipeline that releases verified local edits to reveal and eliminate search artifacts in supervision, training a ranker that far outperforms baselines and boosting miniF2F proof compression savings from 19.7% to 27.5%.
